items.title: investingLive Asia-Pacific market news: KOSDAQ jumps nearly 5% as AI rebounds, oil firms
items.summary: Three reasons Goldman has added another Fed rate hike to its forecast, higher and higher! Morgan Stanley’s Wilson: correction in final phase, three reasons oil can fall into 2027 Asia midday: Nikkei up for third day, KOSDAQ jumps 5% as AI stocks rebound CoreWeave stock jumps nearly 13% after earnings.
items.summaryZh: 高盛在预测中添加另一次美联储加息的三个原因，越来越高！摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)的威尔逊(Wilson) ：最后阶段的修正，石油可能在2027年亚洲中午下跌的三个原因：日经指数(Nikkei)连续第三天上涨， KOSDAQ上涨5% ，因为人工智能股票在盈利后反弹CoreWeave股票，上涨近13%。
